name: GrainVerb
description: Deep wet reverb continuously feeds an SDRAM capture buffer; touch freezes it into a granular cloud. X/FEEL = density, Y/SIZE = reverb depth. ENV / SYNC / SPRD / TONE / REVS. MIX = dry/wet.

params.name: FEEL
params.detail: Grain density: sparse stitches ↔ dense overlapping cloud

params.name: SIZE
params.detail: Reverb tank depth / decay (feeds the grain source)

params.name: MIX
params.detail: 0 = dry only, max = granular reverb cloud only
